_note: Units are tonnes. base_price is credits per tonne at target stock. Tune freely.

water_ice.name: Water ice
water_ice.description: Lunar polar ice. Drinking water, air, propellant and radiation shielding all start here.

oxygen.name: Oxygen
oxygen.description: Split from water. Every habitat breathes it.

propellant.name: Propellant
propellant.description: Hydrogen reaction mass for fusion drives. Ships refuel from the local stock.

regolith.name: Regolith
regolith.description: Lunar soil. Bulk feedstock for smelters and radiation berms.

refined_metals.name: Metal powders
refined_metals.description: Print-grade iron, aluminium and titanium powder, smelted from regolith. What most printers out here eat.

helium3.name: Helium-3
helium3.description: Fusion fuel skimmed from lunar soil. Light, rare and very valuable on Earth.

electronics.name: Compute cores
electronics.description: Processors and mind-grade accelerators. A few tonnes run a town; most still come up the skyhooks from Earth.

food.name: Staples
food.description: Vat-grown protein, hydroponic greens, flour and rice. Cheap, filling, made almost everywhere.

machine_parts.name: Machine parts
machine_parts.description: Pumps, bearings, actuators. Everything out here breaks eventually.

habitat_modules.name: Habitat modules
habitat_modules.description: Pressure-hull sections ready to bolt together.

deuterium.name: Deuterium
deuterium.description: Heavy hydrogen, the other half of fusion fuel. Martian water is five times richer in it than Earth's.

volatiles.name: Volatiles
volatiles.description: Ammonia, methane and nitrogen: fertiliser, air buffer and chemical feedstock the inner system is always short of.

platinum_metals.name: Platinum metals
platinum_metals.description: Platinum, iridium, osmium. Catalysts and electrodes; a metal asteroid has more of them than all Earth's mines.

storage_lattices.name: Storage lattices
storage_lattices.description: Dense crystal memory. Minds, archives and the Feed's endless footage all need more of it.

sensors_optics.name: Sensors and optics
sensors_optics.description: Cameras, spectrometers and transparent-ceramic lenses for every survey, claim and telescope.

robotics.name: Drones and robotics
robotics.description: Diggers, welders and handlers: the forty pairs of hands behind every three-person start-up.

polymer_feed.name: Polymer feed
polymer_feed.description: Plastics and resins in spools and pellets, cracked from volatiles.

bio_feed.name: Bio feed
bio_feed.description: Culture media and organics for vat food, medicines and printed tissue.

ceramic_feed.name: Ceramic and glass feed
ceramic_feed.description: Silicates sintered from regolith, for windows, insulators and pressure vessels.

carbon_fibre.name: Carbon fibre and graphene
carbon_fibre.description: Spun carbon for trusses, tethers and hulls. Titan and the carbon-rich rocks make the best.

gene_stock.name: Seeds and gene stock
gene_stock.description: Seed banks, embryos and tailored strains for new crops on new worlds. Biology is still being explored, and every farm wants the latest.

delicacies.name: Earth delicacies
delicacies.description: Real coffee, chocolate, cheese and fresh fruit. Nothing grown in a vat tastes quite like home.

wine_spirits.name: Fine wine and spirits
wine_spirits.description: Old vintages, single malts and good beer from Earth, plus the odd bold Martian bottle.

handmade_goods.name: Handmade goods
handmade_goods.description: Clothes, instruments and furniture that a person made with their hands. Out here that is a luxury.

keepsakes.name: Keepsakes and antiques
keepsakes.description: Heirlooms, old books, a grandmother's clock: a piece of home to set on a shelf in the dark.

orbital_pharma.name: Orbital pharmaceuticals
orbital_pharma.description: Drugs and crystals grown in microgravity, purer than anything made under a sky. Earth pays well.

collectibles.name: Frontier collectibles
collectibles.description: The first Martian vintage, art carved from comet ice, things the Feed made famous. Earth collects them.
